The bands oscillate between broad, gentle curves and highly compressed structures, evolving over time into structured channels that delineate main currents. Within these channels, smaller micro-eddies emerge as intricate, repeating movements that add localized turbulence to the overall rhythmic tide. The visualization uses a combination of sine wave oscillation, color gradients, and layered horizontal bands to create an abstract yet evocative representation of tidal flow patterns.
